certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in SEC 10-K filings or official security documentation. Zillow's 10-K references NIST Cybersecurity Framework and Cyber Risk Institute Cyber Profile but does not claim SOC 2 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. While Zillow conducts internal audit teams' security controls testing and engages external auditors for compliance testing, ISO 27001 certification is not mentioned in SEC filings or official documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of formal GDPR certification (GDPR is a regulation, not a certification); the previous proof quote attributed to this page was not verbatim (actual nearby text reads 'Zillow Group may choose or be required by law to provide different or additional disclosures...', not 'Zillow may provide...') and does not itself reference GDPR. The vendor's privacy notice is reported by secondary sources to invoke GDPR/UK GDPR legal bases (Article 6) for EEA/UK residents, but the page returns 403 to automated fetch, so the literal on-page wording could not be independently confirmed.

certifications.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Zillow's information security function is 'informed by standards promoted by the National Institute of Standards and Technology cybersecurity framework.' Security program design guided by Cyber Risk Institute's Cyber Profile.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. HIPAA (health insurance portability) is not applicable to Zillow's core real estate business and is not mentioned in compliance documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in available documentation. While Zillow processes financial data for real estate transactions, PCI DSS certification is not explicitly claimed in SEC filings or public security pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: ChatGPT integration explicitly designed to prevent data reuse for training: 'ChatGPT cannot use data displayed in the Zillow App outside of the Zillow experience and does not retain any record of what Zillow displayed.' OpenAI cannot train on IDX (MLS) data. Zillow worked with OpenAI to restrict any use of Zillow App data for training. However, Zillow AI mode uses custom AI models trained on Zillow's own data — the training posture for internal models on customer interaction data is not explicitly disclosed as opt-out-able.

flags: OVER-CLAIM RISK: Zillow is a large enterprise with sophisticated security practices (CISO, internal audits, third-party assessments, NIST alignment) but does NOT publicly hold formal third-party certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) despite being a major B2B and B2C platform. This is either an authentic gap (Zillow relies on internal controls + regulatory compliance rather than third-party certs) or an intentional avoidance of external audit scrutiny.

DOCUMENTATION GAP: Zillow's privacy portal and security pages return 403 Forbidden or minimal content when fetched, limiting direct verification of compliance details. Information derived from SEC 10-K cybersecurity disclosures and press releases rather than direct trust center access.

AI TRAINING POSTURE PARTIALLY UNCLEAR: ChatGPT integration is well-documented with data isolation and no-training guarantees. However, Zillow AI mode's own custom AI models' training on customer interaction data (e.g., user preferences, search patterns across sessions) is not explicitly disclosed as opt-out-able or restricted.
DPA ABSENCE: No Data Processing Agreement mentioned on public pages. Enterprise/B2B customers may have negotiated DPAs, but no standard vendor-facing DPA document publicly available.

GDPR CLAIM CORRECTED: Prior draft marked GDPR held=true using a proof quote that was not verbatim (misquoted the privacy notice's disclosures sentence, which does not itself mention GDPR) and conflated a regulation with a certification. Downgraded to held=false / no independently-confirmed on-page evidence; the privacy notice's page returns 403 to automated fetch.

NO HIPAA/PCI DSS CLAIMS: While Zillow processes financial data in real estate transactions and offers agent/investor tools, no HIPAA or PCI DSS certifications claimed. Likely out of scope (HIPAA for healthcare only; PCI DSS may apply to payment processing but not claimed).

IDENTITY CONFIRMED: Verified vendor is Zillow Group Inc. (NASDAQ: ZG), public company, real estate platform. Zillow AI is their new generative AI mode launched Q1 2026. No conflation with similarly-named vendors.
